user.title: NL-Alert — location
user.description:
Monitor NL-Alert public warnings for your location.

Speakers, alarm sound, voice and notifications are configured afterwards in the NL-Alert panel in the sidebar.

error.missing_coordinates: Latitude and longitude are required when not using the home location.

init.title: NL-Alert
init.description: All settings — speakers, alarm sound, voice, notifications and the tests — live in the NL-Alert panel in the sidebar (/nl-alert).

test_alert.name: Test alert
test_alert.description: Send a synthetic NL-Alert through your configured dispatch (alarm + TTS + push).

message.name: Message
message.description: Optional custom message. A built-in test message is used by default.

kind.name: Test type
kind.description: Which part of the dispatch to run: full, alarm, announcement or notify.

holiday_integration_missing.title: NL-Alert needs the Holiday integration
holiday_integration_missing.description: The monthly siren test is switched on, but Home Assistant has no holiday calendar to check against. The test is skipped every month until you add the **Holiday** integration (Settings → Devices & services → Add integration → Holiday, country: Netherlands). Without it, NL-Alert cannot tell whether the first Monday is a public holiday — and sounding a siren on a holiday is worse than staying silent.
